in_marathi.name: Banhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Banhi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘banana’ which means ‘banana tree’. This name is believed to bring prosperity and abundance. Banana trees are often associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
